verdict.rationale: Paxos documents rule-based orchestrations that fire automatically when bank transfers arrive and convert fiat to stablecoin (or redeem to bank) without manual steps. Payments can also auto-convert stablecoin to fiat, and webhooks with 24-hour retries let external systems react to platform events asynchronously. These automations are limited to predefined money-movement flows, so the user cannot author general-purpose background automations. Missing for 10: general user-defined automation or workflow builder, scheduled/recurring jobs, agent-driven autonomous execution, independent or hands-on corroboration.
